main_text.head: SERENISSIMO ET POTENTISSIMO PRINCIPI, DOMINO FRIDERICO WILHELMO, MARCHIONI Brandenburgico, Sacri Romani Imperii ARCHICAMERARIO, & Principi ELECTORI; Prussiæ, Magdeburgi, Juliaci, Clivið, Montium, Stetini, Pomeraniæ, Cassubiorum Vandalorúmque, nec non in Silesia Crosna & Suibusfiæ DUCI; Norinbergensi BURGGRAVIO; Halberstadii, Mindæ & Camini PRINCIPI; Marcæ, Hohenzolleræ, & Ravensbergi COMITI; DOMINO in Ravensperg, Lauenburg, & Bütau;
DOMINO MEO CLEMENTISSIMO.
main_text.p: Difficilima & deploratissima sunt, in quorum maturitatem Deus, justo equidem sanctóque, sed paterno eodem erga domum & familiam suam judicio usus,

page.notes: The title block is set in red and black roman and italic capitals; the large red "DOMINO MEO" and "FRIDERICO WILHELMO" are display type. The opening "D" is a red woodcut initial, joined to "ifficilima" as "Difficilima". Some words in the title are italic and are marked as such only in the heading text above where practical. Edge damage and stains at the left and right margins; no legible marginal text.
